verdict.rationale: Zero's own MCP capability list explicitly includes bulk delete and bulk archive, so an AI agent can act on many emails at once. That is real first-party bulk support, but it is limited to two operation types. It is documented only as a one-line prose claim with no endpoint schema, and it is authenticated by copying a browser session cookie. missing for 10: bulk operations beyond delete/archive (e.g. bulk labeling or mark-read), documentation of selection criteria and scale limits, an API schema, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Bulk delete emails - Bulk archive emails
